images.caption: Figure 1:(1):MaLoWinternalizes the history context into time-evolving, lightweight parameter updates (LoRA) of a streaming VLM. At each step, the streaming VLM takes the current observation and user query as input, and performs inference using the updated LoRA weights.(2): By separating memory from the input,MaLoWpreserves the performance on real-time perception while significantly improves the performance of memory-critical, backward tracing tasks.

Figure 2:Overview ofMaLoW.(1)MaLoWinternalizes history into LoRA weights applied to a base VLM that processes only the current observation.(2)Context encoding compresses visual tokensVt−1V_{t-1}and timestamp tokensTt−1T_{t-1}into a compact representationqt−1q_{t-1}using a learnable queryQQ.(3)Hidden state updatesmtm_{t}that captures local dynamics andsts_{t}that preserves global semantics.(4)LoRA weights are decoded from the hidden states.(5)sts_{t}is updated through gated summation.
